name: UC7 - NGO/NPO/Charity/Trust Account & Donation-Title Integrity Monitor (Final)
notes: Calls the ml_api service (app.py) for governing-body name screening and title similarity. Falls back to Postgres pg_trgm fuzzy match only if the ML API is unreachable (Reg 6 error-handling policy). Set ML_API_BASE_URL as an n8n environment variable, e.g. http://ml-api:5000

parameters.query: SELECT ngo_account_id, customer_id, registered_title FROM ngo_accounts;

SELECT customer_id, member->>'name' AS name, member->>'cnic' AS cnic FROM ngo_accounts, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(governing_body, '[]'::jsonb)) AS member WHERE ngo_account_id = {{ $json.ngo_account_id || 0 }};

nodes.name: ML API — Screen Member (match-name)
nodes.notes: Reg 6 §3: screens governing body member against watchlists (DP/PP) + pep_list, returns a calibrated match_probability, not a guessed number.

parameters.query: SELECT *, GREATEST(similarity(lower(entity_name), lower('{{ $json.name }}')), CASE WHEN id_number = '{{ $json.cnic }}' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) as match_prob, 'fallback_pg_trgm' as source FROM (SELECT entity_name, id_number FROM watchlists UNION ALL SELECT full_name AS entity_name, id_number FROM pep_list) w ORDER BY match_prob DESC LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Fallback — Postgres pg_trgm Match
nodes.notes: Only reached if ML API call above fails (continueOnFail). Deterministic fuzzy-text fallback per error-handling policy: if ML similarity service is down, default to strict fuzzy/exact match and flag for manual review.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO alerts (related_table, related_id, alert_type, severity, status) VALUES ('ngo_accounts', {{ $node["Postgres — Fetch NGO Accounts"].json.ngo_account_id || 0 }}, 'DPPP_MEMBER', 'high', 'open');

nodes.name: Postgres — Insert Alert (DPPP_MEMBER)
nodes.notes: Reg 6 §6: any positive DP/PP/PEP match on a governing body member must be logged and considered for STR/other action.

parameters.query: SELECT n.advertised_title, a.account_number FROM ngo_accounts n JOIN accounts a ON n.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.account_type = 'ngo' AND a.customer_id = {{ $node["Postgres — Fetch NGO Accounts"].json.customer_id || 0 }} LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Postgres — Fetch Solicitation / Ad Ingestion
nodes.notes: In production this row is populated by a webhook from the ad-monitoring/ingestion tool, not scanned from transactions — kept as-is here to match the sandbox synthetic data pattern.

parameters.query: SELECT registered_title FROM ngo_accounts WHERE ngo_account_id = {{ $node["Postgres — Fetch NGO Accounts"].json.ngo_account_id || 0 }};

nodes.name: ML API — Title Similarity (match-title)
nodes.notes: Reg 6 §4: calibrated similarity, not exact-string equality, so abbreviations aren't false-flagged.

parameters.query: UPDATE accounts SET status = 'dormant', frozen_reason = 'Caution Hold - Title Mismatch (Reg 6 §4)' WHERE account_number = '{{ $node["Postgres — Fetch Solicitation / Ad Ingestion"].json.account_number }}';

INSERT INTO alerts (related_table, related_id, alert_type, severity, status) VALUES ('ngo_accounts', {{ $node["Postgres — Fetch NGO Accounts"].json.ngo_account_id || 0 }}, 'TITLE_MISMATCH', 'high', 'open') RETURNING alert_id;

nodes.name: RAG — Retrieve Reg 6 §4 Clause
nodes.notes: Grounds the LLM narrative in the exact clause text so nothing is hallucinated.

nodes.name: AI Agent — Draft STR Narrative (LLM)
nodes.notes: Uses a credential-stored API key (nodeCredentialType), never a hard-coded key in the JSON.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO str_reports (customer_id, narrative, status) VALUES ({{ $node["Postgres — Fetch NGO Accounts"].json.customer_id || 0 }}, '{{ $json.choices[0].message.content.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'draft') RETURNING str_id;

nodes.notes: Reg 6 §1 / Reg 7 §1: no STR is ever auto-filed. A human compliance officer must approve via the resume webhook.
